pages.title: Kobolds
text: Kobolds live wherever there is something worth digging, and they do not share it.

pages.title: Two kinds
text: - **Ridge Kobold**: the dark caves under the Glimmer Ridge.
- **Geode Kobold**: the dark caves under the Crystal Fields.
Both rise in the dark day or night, one to three at a time. A kobold has **21 health** and **2 armour**, is quick, and hits for **4**.

pages.title: What they give
text: A Ridge Kobold drops **1 to 2 Kobold Scales**, a Geode Kobold **1 to 2 Kobold Horns**, more with Looting. Both are Hound reagents: see [reagents](reagents).
